summary_note: Section 5.32. Section 5.31's block, statistic and question, with the statistic declared as a one-sided paired sign-flip permutation test on the mean and the block sized ~4x from section 5.31's observed effect and spread. Both primaries are on the FUSED loss, signed so a win is the primary's prediction: fused(Q) - fused(R) < 0 and fused(R) - fused(B) < 0. Every comparison stores the mean, its standard error, the permutation p and the sign-test p together, so a failure can be read as 'no effect' or 'no resolution' rather than guessed at.
